segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin says her cheeks still get dry in cooler months but the toner has responded well overall, and another describes it as suitable for oily skin, reducing shine.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin generally report no tightness or stripping and note it feels hydrating and soothing, though one notes it did not fully resolve her dry skin and another found it slightly drying and layers moisturizer on top.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe it as absorbing well, reducing shine, smoothing texture, and generally not causing breakouts, though one combination-skin reviewer got an under-the-skin pimple.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the most numerous group and overwhelmingly report calming of redness and irritation with no flare-ups, though one reviewer with sensitive skin experienced a small breakout on the forehead.
segments.mature: One reviewer describes using it on her 88-year-old aunt with good results and no dryness, and another notes it helped her skin look youthful again.

concerns.aging: Two reviewers mention mature or aging skin, reporting a youthful, glowing look and good tolerance without dryness, including one used on an 88-year-old relative.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including those with dry skin, report the toner hydrates without leaving tightness, stickiness, or a stripped feeling; one reviewer nonetheless found it a little drying and one dry-skin reviewer felt it wasn't enough on its own.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers, mostly with sensitive skin, report visible calming of redness and irritation, including on days skin is 'acting up' or post-breakout, with no dissent reported.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer specifically credits it with supporting the skin barrier without stripping or damage, and others note it can be layered under stronger actives like tretinoin or clindamycin without added irritation.
concerns.spots: A few reviewers report brightened skin and fewer dark spots or more even tone after regular use; no negative reports on this concern.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts, but one sensitive-skin reviewer had a small forehead breakout and one combination-skin reviewer got an under-the-skin pimple attributed to the mild exfoliation.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin report reduced shine and a balanced, non-greasy feel after application, with no complaints of increased oiliness.

extraits.texte: So I have been using the product for a week and it feels very nice on my skin. I would have to wait a bit to see what the full effects are but it feels light and nice on the skin. It did break me out on the forehead a bit but other than that its fine. I do have sensitive skin btw.

thank you skin 1004 for gifting me this toner! first things first i was very excited to try this toner bc i had never heard of centella or pha acids before. the toner itself was gentle enough for everyday and didn't irritate my hand eczema which is a plus with me using any exfoliating toner. i used it twice a day for a week and did notice the dead skin off my face but without having my face feel dry like it would with a retinol product. my skin also looked noticeably brighter which was another huge plus. i would compare this product to a glycolic toner but without leaving the skin dry and leaving you with brighter skin. my only downfall was that i noticeed my undereye skin was a bit more dry :( i do happen to have dry undereyes since i am in my 30s but if i was still in my 20s this product would indeed be a staple in my routine. all in all if you dont have dry undereyes i would highly recommend this toner!

I started using the product and noticed the fragrance is very light and not overwhelming, it definitely doesn't leave a sticky residue like some toners might, and two swipes with two different cotton pads got excess oil off. The exfoliation (while very mild) did cause an under the skin pimple, but I have combination skin and new products sometimes do that for me. Overall, it's a really nice formula that I will continue to use.

I have dry skin, I'm not acne-prone, and this toner has become a reliable step in my extensive Korean skincare routine. The texture is lightweight and watery, but it's surprisingly comforting — it sinks in quickly without leaving any tightness or residue. My skin immediately feels calmed, refreshed, and balanced, which makes it a perfect prep step before essences and serums. The Centella really shines here: it reduces redness and sensitivity without feeling like a "treatment" product. Despite being a toning toner, it's not stripping at all. My skin stays soft and receptive rather than dry or squeaky. I often apply it in 2–3 layers using the patting method, and it layers beautifully without pilling. This is not a flashy, instant-glow product — it's a quiet, skin-health staple. If you have dry, sensitive, or dehydrated skin and want something that supports your routine rather than competing with it, this is an excellent choice. Best for: dry, sensitive, or barrier-focused routines Not ideal if: you're looking for exfoliation or actives

I received this product from Skin1004 in exchange for my honest opinion and it does what it says it does! Provides mild exfoliation without stripping skin of its natural oils and tones skin very well. I have slightly textured skin and this toner noticeably smooths out texture leaving my skin feeling extra soft. It doesn't dry out my skin and doesn't leave a sticky residue. There's a lot of toners that don't absorb into my skin like this one does. Note that I have combination skin and after using this toner, my face feels clean and nourished reducing shine from having oily skin. It hasn't made me breakout at all and provides instant hydration. I love that this toner has Centella Asiatica extract from Madagascar as a main ingredient.

extraits.titre: This line has transformed my skin
extraits.texte: I love this line so much! It's taken my skin from dry and dull to supple and soft. I've never used anything from the centella line that I didn't like. My favorite way to use the toner is "flooding". After cleansing I will apply about 5-7 thin layers, allowing it to dry in between and then finishing off with the moisturizer. I wake up GLOWING! Highly recommend!
I do really like this toner and feel it's great at exfoliating. It's a little drying but I layer more moisturizing products on top. Overall I do recommend
